4.9.2.6 Examples for the Formula Language expressions
Examples of correct arithmetic expressions are3:
<APPLICATION-VALUE-SPECIFICATION>
<SW-VALUE-CONT>
<SW-VALUES-PHYS>
<VF>1</VF>
</SW-VALUES-PHYS>
</SW-VALUE-CONT>
</APPLICATION-VALUE-SPECIFICATION>
...
<VF>2.0</VF>
...
...
<VF>1.5E5</VF>
...
...
<VF>2.0 * (1 + 2)</VF>
...
...
<VF>2 > 1</VF>
...
The grammar is defined for strings AFTER replacement of the entities.
...
<VF>2 > 1</VF>
3Note that the example does not reflect the BINDING-TIME
Generic Structure Template
...
When looking in real ARXML-Files, e.g. with a text editor, one may find entities in the
formula expression. Entities are things like
>
standing for "‘>"’.

formula
language
expression
are
available
as
test
cases
in

[AUTOSAR_TP_FormulaLanguage_TestCase_Blueprint.arxml]. For further examples
with references see content below [TPS_GST_00265].
